title: Geology of the Fort Jackson North quadrangle, Richland County, South Carolina
citation: Smith,John, Brown,E.J., and Jones,K.M., 1961, Geology of the Fort Jackson North quadrangle, Richland County, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Map Series MS-3, map scale 1:24,000.
notes: Single OCR'd map sheet with text. The sheet names W. K. Pooser and H. S Johnson, Jr. (1961) as authors; the catalog citation names other authors and year - catalog record should be checked. Map symbols read from legend boxes on a page-image tile. Section A-A' (vertical exaggeration 4) read from tiles: end labels, axis units and unit labels only; it has no drill holes and no distance scale, so contacts were not digitized; a fault is drawn near Carys Lakes. Strike and dip numbers on the map face not recorded (no printed locations). Kaolin cone and sand SiO2 figures are not tests of the schema kinds; not recorded. Mine and pit symbols not recorded. SUBSURFACE: Tuscaloosa base contact dips SE about 30 ft per mile (in unit contacts).
